result:
The scan crashed on fork PRs because the workflow passed `--nvdApiKey` with the secret's value inline, and GitHub gives fork PRs an empty secret. The fix in #6210 only adds the flag when the secret is set, so the scan runs without a key. I could not find a ticket key for this fix.

**Why it crashed only on forks.** Before commit `8ec94d2` (PR #6210), the args ran `--nvdApiKey ${{ secrets.NVD_API_KEY }}` unconditionally. The diff shows that line as the only change in the fix. GitHub does not pass repository secrets to workflows triggered by fork PRs, so the expansion was empty and Dependency-Check received `--nvdApiKey` with no value. That is my reading of the diff plus GitHub's documented secret behaviour; I did not see the failing run logs. Pushes to the protected branches had the secret, so they were unaffected.

**Why it ran on every PR.** The workflow then had a `pull_request` trigger on `master`, so any fork PR ran the scan regardless of what it changed. Commit `be8716784` ("Run OWASP dependency check on all 2.x branches and remove PR runs") removed that trigger. The workflow now runs only on `push` to `master` and `2.*.x`, so fork PRs no longer start the scan at all.

**How the key is handled now.** The args line is `${{ secrets.NVD_API_KEY != '' && format('--nvdApiKey {0}', secrets.NVD_API_KEY) || '' }}`. When the secret is empty, the flag is omitted and the scan runs without an NVD API key. The rest of the args (`--failOnCVSS 6.2`, `--enableRetired`, suppressions) are unchanged. The job timeout was separately raised to 60 minutes in `cbc9b9d` (PR #6277), which is unrelated to the fork crash.

**Ticket.** The fix commit `8ec94d2` has an empty body and references only PR #6210. A search of the repository found no TRUNK key linked to the NVD or OWASP change, so I have not given a ticket.
